line.text: A few small things for the speech, up to three. Each card is already costed, and its price is the headroom left the morning after. Keeping the headroom is an announcement too.
One notch beyond what you chose turns a promise kept into a promise exceeded. Ministers notice; so does the department that must spend it.
No rabbit: the headroom is the announcement, and the bond market is the audience. Budget 2025 made a virtue of more than doubling the margin; you can make the same speech.
